name: TP5100
description: TP5100 降圧スイッチング式 リチウムイオン充電IC (QFN-16 4x4)。1セル 4.2V / 2セル 8.4V を CS 端子で切替 (開放=4.2V、VREG につなぐ=8.4V、GND=停止)。入力 4.5〜12V。充電電流 = 0.1 ÷ Rs[Ω] [A] (Rs は VS-BAT 間、0.1Ωで1A、最大2A)。プリチャージ(1セル2.9V/2セル5.8V未満) → 定電流 → 定電圧、満充電後に 80%まで下がると再充電。RTRICK 端子の抵抗でプリチャージ電流を設定 (50kで20%、開放で100%)。TS は電池の温度検出 (GND につなぐと無効)。VIN はピン1,4,5,16、LX はピン2,3 をまとめて「VIN」「LX」として扱います (パッドは同じ接続)。スイッチングは平均化した動作モデルで、リップル・損失・熱制限・入力電流の降圧効果は扱いません (入力電流は出力電流と同じ)。数値は概算

sim.name: TP5100
sim.text:
.subckt TP5100 vin lx pwr gnd vs bat vreg ts rtrick cs stdby chrg
* TP5100 behavioural model (averaged buck charger): the switching is replaced by a voltage source on LX.
* Control signals are in "sense volts": 0.1 V across Rs = full current.
* internal 5 V supply (VREG) once VIN is above the under-voltage lockout
Bvr vr 0 V=5*step(V(vin)-3.6,0.02)
Rvr vr vreg 1
Rvl vreg 0 1Meg
* CS: left open = single cell (4.2 V), high = two cells (8.4 V), low = shut down
Rcs1 vreg cs 1Meg
Rcs2 cs 0 1Meg
Bdbl dbl 0 V=step(V(cs)-4,0.1)
Bvfl vfl 0 V=4.2+4.2*V(dbl)
Bvtk vtk 0 V=2.9+2.9*V(dbl)
* trickle current as a fraction of the full current: 0.1 + 0.9 x V(RTRICK); 50k gives 20 %, open gives 100 %
Vone one 0 DC 1
Rtr1 one rtrick 400k
Rtr2 rtrick 0 1G
Bf f 0 V=0.1+0.9*V(rtrick)
* the charger runs when VIN is above the cell by 0.1 V and above 3.6 V, CS is not low and the cell temperature is fine
* (TS tied to GND or left open = no temperature check; otherwise 45 % to 80 % of VREG)
Bts tsok 0 V=min(1,step(0.1-V(ts),0.01)+step(V(ts)-2.25,0.02)*step(4-V(ts),0.02))
Bon on 0 V=step(V(vin)-V(bat)-0.1,0.01)*step(V(vin)-3.6,0.02)*step(V(cs)-1,0.05)*V(tsok)
Rtsl ts 0 10Meg
* the reference is a full 0.1 V above the trickle threshold and the trickle fraction below it;
* near the float voltage the voltage loop reduces it (full current within 50 mV of the float voltage)
Bcmd cmd 0 V=V(on)*min(0.1*(V(f)+(1-V(f))*step(V(bat)-V(vtk),0.01)),2*(V(vfl)-V(bat)))
* LX = cell voltage + 100 V/V x (command - sense) + an integral term, limited to 0 .. VIN
Bint 0 cint I=0.02*(V(cmd)-V(vs,bat))
Cint cint 0 1u
Rint cint 0 10k
Blx ls 0 V=limit(V(bat)+100*(V(cmd)-V(vs,bat))+V(cint),0,V(vin))
Vsn ls ls2 0
Sd ls2 lx ls2 lx SWD
Rlx lx 0 100Meg
* input current: output power over the efficiency (90 %) and the input voltage
Bin vin 0 I=I(Vsn)*V(bat)/(0.9*max(V(vin),1))
Riq vin 0 75k
* status (open drain): CHRG low while charging, STDBY low when the cell is full (current under a tenth)
Bfull full 0 V=V(on)*step(0.01-V(vs,bat),0.002)*step(V(bat)-(V(vfl)-0.15),0.01)
Bchg chg 0 V=V(on)*(1-V(full))
Sch chrg 0 chg 0 SWO
Ssb stdby 0 full 0 SWO
Rch chrg 0 100Meg
Rsb stdby 0 100Meg
* PWR_ON- is low while VIN is present, otherwise it follows the cell
Bpw pw 0 V=step(V(vin)-3.6,0.02)
Bnpw npw 0 V=1-V(pw)
Spo pwr 0 pw 0 SWO
Sph pwr bat npw 0 SWO
Rpw pwr 0 100Meg
.model SWD SW(RON=0.17 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.002)
.model SWO SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=0.5 VW=0.1)
.ends TP5100
